Bounded automatic final-state evidence.description: Place first in an alpha.39+ program. Explicit snapshot and automatic final state remain separate; not encryption or scientific certification.

Dimension-checked array maths.description: Element-wise square root with dimensional checks and an independent result array; run with alpha.33+.

Explicit IID bootstrap.description: Explicit IID replacement percentile endpoints, not an automatic coverage guarantee; use a fresh stream if already seeded.

Seeded scientific randomness.description: Reproducible scientific PCG32 stream, not cryptographic randomness.

Everyday program.description: Start a program without GO_PARANOID or seal; outputs remain run-confined and hashed.

Paranoid program.description: Start a paranoid-mode program with one sealed value.

Assignment.description: Assign an expression to a name.

Print value.description: Print a named value using interpolation.

Formatted output.description: Print a numeric SI value with explicit precision.

Seal artifact.description: Preserve the current value as a run artifact.

For range loop.description: Half-open integer loop with a shared 1,000,000-iteration ceiling.

For each array value.description: Iterate an independent one-dimensional array value.

Continue loop.description: Start the nearest loop's next iteration.

While loop.description: Boolean-condition loop with a shared iteration ceiling.

If, else if, else.description: Boolean conditions; only the selected branch executes.

Switch cases.description: First exact matching case; no fallthrough.

G funk function.description: Define a local-scope function with an explicit return.

Parse a checked number.description: Convert finite, unitless decimal text to a quantity; invalid text fails.

Scientific square root.description: Real square root with checked domain and even unit exponents.

Scientific hypotenuse.description: Hypotenuse of two quantities with matching dimensions.

Astronomical units to metres.description: Convert an explicit number of astronomical units to SI metres.

Vector products.description: Dimension-checked homogeneous vector magnitude, dot, and cross products.

Spherical coordinates in degrees.description: Convert radius, inclination from +z, and azimuth from +x to [x, y, z].

Rotational motion.description: Explicit degree-based angular velocity, tangential speed, and centripetal acceleration.

Parse a checked integer.description: Convert decimal integer text within the exact f64 range; invalid text fails.

Split and join text.description: Split text into an array and join its text parts.

Ask for one line.description: Interactive text input; responses are preserved in the run evidence.

Program argument.description: Read a zero-based program argument after the -- separator.

Array and independent slice.description: Create an array and an independent half-open slice.

Append array item.description: Assign a new copy with one appended item.

FITS table mean.description: Read a numeric FITS binary-table column mean.

FITS selected statistics.description: Full-table half-open selection with optional positive weights. Result is [selected, used, weight sum, mean].

Explicit tolerance comparison.description: All four arguments required. Absolute tolerance matches operand dimensions; relative tolerance is dimensionless.

Exact floating-point bits.description: Compare finite f64 bits of matching dimensions, including the sign of zero; not evidence verification.

CSV result.description: Write a run-confined CSV result; GO_PARANOID is optional.

input_secret.description: Read a masked password in GO_PRIVATE only. No scientific input event or replay file. Returns ordinary in-memory text; never print real passwords.

encrypt_text.description: GO_PRIVATE only: authenticated age encryption of UTF-8 text into a new file; minimum 12-byte passphrase. Returns true; errors stop execution.

encrypt_file.description: GO_PRIVATE only: age-encrypt an existing regular file to a new destination. No overwrite or scientific receipt.

decrypt_file.description: GO_PRIVATE only: authenticate fully before publishing a new plaintext file; exact binary bytes. Returns true or refuses.

decrypt_text.description: GO_PRIVATE only: authenticate and decode at most 1 MiB UTF-8 plaintext in memory. Does not create a plaintext file.

read_text.description: GO_PRIVATE only: read at most 1 MiB UTF-8 from a regular file. Returns raw text; print() is an explicit plaintext disclosure.

display_file.description: GO_PRIVATE only: display a bounded UTF-8 file with terminal controls escaped. Explicit plaintext disclosure; returns true.

str_b64.description: Encode UTF-8 as RFC 4648 standard padded Base64, at most 1 MiB output. Encoding only, NOT encryption; ordinary run evidence remains plaintext.

str_to_b64.description: Alias for str_b64: standard padded Base64; not encryption.

str_from_b64.description: Decode canonical standard padded Base64 to UTF-8. Refuses whitespace, URL alphabet, invalid padding bits and non-UTF-8 output.

net_demo_credentials.description: GO_PRIVATE only. Create a new owner-only directory containing fresh CA/server/client PEM credentials, valid 90 days for localhost learning. Refuses existing paths. CA signing key is not saved; never share private demo keys.

net_allow.description: GO_PRIVATE only. Permit this exact numeric IP:port for the current execution. Loopback is allowed by default; wildcard, broadcast and multicast addresses are refused. Not an OS firewall or sandbox.

net_timeout.description: GO_PRIVATE only. Set total per-operation deadline in integer milliseconds, 1–60000; default 30000. Partial traffic does not reset the deadline.

net_listen.description: GO_PRIVATE only. Bind a TLS 1.3 listener requiring a trusted client certificate. Numeric IP:port; loopback by default. Returns a handle. No plaintext or certificate bypass.

net_connect.description: GO_PRIVATE only. TLS 1.3 with verified server certificate/name and mandatory client identity. Explicit PEM CA; numeric endpoint; no DNS/proxy/redirect/fallback. Returns a connection handle.

net_accept.description: GO_PRIVATE only. Accept one mutually authenticated TLS 1.3 connection within the total timeout. Each listener is synchronous; no automatic concurrent server or application authorization.

net_send.description: GO_PRIVATE only. Send one UTF-8 message, at most 1 MiB, with a four-byte big-endian length prefix inside TLS. Transport failure retires the connection. Delivery/application processing is not guaranteed by send success.

net_receive.description: GO_PRIVATE only. Receive one bounded UTF-8 message. Oversized, truncated, invalid-UTF8 or failed frames refuse and retire the connection. Treat received text as untrusted; do not print terminal controls directly.

net_close.description: GO_PRIVATE only. Close a listener or connection; repeated/unknown closes refuse. Handles are owned by one execution and sockets close on drop. Not a secure-erasure guarantee.

net_address.description: GO_PRIVATE only. Return the local numeric socket address for an open listener/connection. Listener port zero selects an ephemeral port.

net_peer_sha256.description: GO_PRIVATE only. Return SHA-256 of the authenticated peer leaf certificate DER. Compare with an independently obtained value for application authorization; this is not a message signature.

e2e_keygen.description: GO_PRIVATE only. Generate an age X25519 identity using OS cryptographic randomness. Write a new owner-only private key and optional new public-key file; return public recipient key. Refuses overwrite; operations are not transactional.

e2e_public_key.description: GO_PRIVATE only. Read an owner-only age identity and return its public recipient key. Refuses symlinks; authenticate the public key independently before distribution.

e2e_encrypt.description: GO_PRIVATE only. Encrypt up to 512 KiB UTF-8 to one age X25519 public recipient; return canonical padded Base64 of standard binary age v1. Relay needs no private key. No sender authentication, replay prevention, forward secrecy or post-quantum claim.

e2e_decrypt.description: GO_PRIVATE only. Authenticate and decrypt an at-most-1-MiB Base64 age message using an owner-only X25519 private-key file. Rejects wrong keys, corruption, truncation, oversized results and scrypt messages. Returns UTF-8 only after full authentication.

net_pair_credentials.description: GO_PRIVATE only. Generate a dedicated 90-day TLS pair for an explicit RFC1918 LAN IPv4 address (loopback allowed for tests). New owner-only directory; separate server/client folders contain only their own private keys. The trusted setup computer sees both identities; no CA signing key is saved. Transfer only the intended role folder through a trusted channel and verify the CA fingerprint independently. Learning setup, not managed production PKI.
